db_assertions.db_measure: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (93.1%) to Cathelicidin-PY K:17%; R: 10%; L:14%, I=L=A:7%. Mol Wt: 3361.028; GRAVY: -0.53; Mol Formula: C151H264N46O39; mol ex coeff: 0. Activity: slightly less active than the WT. active against E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 1 uM), P. aeruginosa SVB-B9 (MIC 4 uM) in MHB, S-aureus ATCC 29213 (MIC>64 uM), and C-albicans SC5314T (MIC >64 uM). Antimicrobial robustness: salt-sensitive; active against E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 4 uM), P. aeruginosa SVB-B9 (MIC 32 uM) in cation-adjusted MHB media. Structure: less helical than WT. UPdated 6/2023

db_assertions.db_subject: Flow-Based Fmoc-SPPS Preparation and SAR Study of Cathelicidin-PY Reveals Selective Antimicrobial Activity.
db_assertions.db_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (93.1%) to Cathelicidin-PY K:21%; L:14%; R: 10%. Peptide engineering: the orginal disulfide bond between C3 and C7 has been replaced with a amide bond between the sidechains of D3 and X7 (2,4-diaminobutyric acid. Warning: represented with K in this sequence). Activity: active against E. coli ATCC 25922 (1 uM), P. aeruginosa SVB-B9 (MIC 8 uM) in MHB, S-aureus ATCC 29213 (MIC>64 uM), and C-albicans SC5314T (MIC >64 uM). Antimicrobial robustness: salt-sensitive; active against E. coli ATCC 25922 (4 uM), P. aeruginosa SVB-B9 (MIC 32 uM) in cation-adjusted MHB media. Structure: more helical than WT. Most helical in TFE in the series!
